text.p: The brokerage unit of Polish Bank Pekao SA has maintained its November 13 buy recommendation for computer maker Optimus SA despite the stock's steep price rise, Pekao said in a report.

"Despite the share price rise from our previous recommendation from 38.8 zlotys to 83 zlotys we're maintaining our 'buy' recommendation," the report dated January 29 and released to the press on Thursday said.
Optimus closed on the Warsaw bourse's main market on Thursday at 106 zlotys.
The report said the firm would benefit from a freeing up of reserves and investment sources as its 300 $100,000 convertible bonds were exchanged.
Last month Optimus said orders to convert 159 of the bonds had led to the freeing up of provisions that helped boost January pre-tax profit.
The firm said it would use its call option on the bonds sometime in this year's first half if it had not already received orders to convert them.

Pekao also said Optimus had benefited from the news it would receive a dividend from cash register subsidiary Optimus IC. Last month the parent company said Optimus IC would net 15 million zlotys in 1997.
Optimus SA expects to lift net profit this year to 30 million zlotys from 16.5 million zlotys in 1996.
